title: pathology-data-mining/mussel-nf pipeline parameters
description: pipeline for running Mussel to extract features and build a reef

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

publish_mode.description: mode used to publish output files

samples_csv.description: samples csv file with slides to process

samples_csv_watch_path.description: watch this path for sample csv files

watch_path.description: watch this path for sample svs files

publish_slide_prefix.description: include first 4 digits of the slide ID in the publish dir

scratch_dir.description: Path to fast local scratch storage for WSI caching (e.g., /scratch/$USER). When set, input WSI files are staged to this directory before processing.

use_one_step_workflow.description: Use one-step tessellation and featurization workflow
use_one_step_workflow.help_text: When true, uses TESSELLATE_FEATURIZE_BATCH for combined tessellation and feature extraction. When false, uses separate TESSELLATE and FEATURIZE_BATCH processes.

filter_model_type.description: Patch encoder used to extract features for legacy tile filtering (e.g. ctranspath).

filter_model_path.description: Path to the .pkl sklearn classifier used by legacy tile filtering.

filter_threshold.description: Confidence threshold for the legacy tile classifier (0–1). Tiles below this score are discarded.

filter_tiles.description: Enable legacy classifier-based tile filtering. After tessellation, extracts patch features with filter_model_type and applies a .pkl classifier to discard non-tissue tiles.

seg_config_group.help_text: Use a predefined segmentation configuration: 'default', 'biopsy', 'resection', or 'tcga'. When null, uses individual segmentation parameters.

overlap.description: Patch overlap in pixels. Default 0 (no overlap). Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

min_tissue_proportion.description: Minimum fraction of a patch that must be tissue to be retained. Default 0.0 (keep all). Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

remove_artifacts.description: Use GrandQC neural artifact remover to exclude artifact regions from the tissue mask during tessellation. Does not require a separate classifier model. Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

remove_penmarks.description: Detect and exclude pen mark regions before tessellation. Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

seg_model.description: Tissue segmentation model used during tessellation: classic (threshold-based) or neural (neural network). If unset, Mussel uses its own default (classic) or the seg_config_group preset value. Requires Mussel v1.2.0+.

model_types.description: models to use for feature extraction

items.description: Patch encoders: resnet50, ctranspath, gigapath, virchow, virchow2, optimus, hoptimus1, h0mini, uni, uni2h, conch1_5, clip, googlepath, phikon, phikon_v2, midnight12k, gpfm, hibou_l. Slide encoders: gigapath_slide, titan_slide, prism_slide, feather_slide, chief_slide, madeleine_slide.

use_gpu.description: use the GPU for feature extraction

batch_size.description: Batch size for tile/patch feature extraction

workflow_batch_size.description: Number of slides grouped into a single Nextflow task. Reduces scheduler overhead.

slide_batch_size.description: Number of slides to process together in a batch (controls both Type 2 and Type 3 batching)

model_batch_sizes.description: Per-model batch sizes for feature extraction. Keys are model names (e.g., ctranspath, optimus), values are integers. If not specified, uses default batch_size.

model_types.description: models that are designated as CLIP-based

default_classes.description: default classes to use for prompt-engineering

oncotree_class_csv.description: mapping of oncotree codes to classes to use for prompt-engineering

annotations_csv.description: mapping of slide IDs to annotation bmp file

annotation_class_mapping_yaml.description: mapping of annotation bmp IDs to class
